tools.name: anomaly_list
tools.title: List Anomalies
tools.description: List HR / operational / financial anomalies detected by the system. Filter by type (duplicate_clock_in, overtime_spike, missing_clock_out, expense_outlier, etc.), severity (low/medium/high/critical), or period. Useful for daily HR review and compliance audits. / Lista anomalias detectadas (RRHH/operativas/financieras) con filtros opcionales.

type.description: Filter by anomaly type slug / Tipo

tools.name: apply_deposit
tools.title: Apply Deposit
tools.description: Apply a deposit to an invoice or mark it as used. Transitions the deposit status to 'applied'. Example: id='dep_abc123', invoiceId='inv_xyz' / Aplica un deposito a una factura o lo marca como utilizado.

invoiceId.description: Invoice ID to apply the deposit to / ID de la factura a la que aplicar el deposito

tools.name: apply_late_fee
tools.title: Apply Late Fee
tools.description: Apply late payment interest to an overdue invoice. Calculates interest based on EU Late Payment Directive (8% default) or auto-calculates from days overdue. Creates a debit note linked to the original invoice. / Aplica intereses de demora a una factura vencida. Calcula intereses segun la Directiva Europea de Morosidad (8% por defecto) o los calcula automaticamente a partir de los dias de retraso. Crea una nota de debito vinculada a la factura original.

invoiceId.description: ID of the overdue invoice / ID de la factura vencida

amount.description: Override fee amount. If omitted, auto-calculated from days overdue and legal rate. / Importe de la comision. Si se omite, se calcula automaticamente.

daysOverdue.description: Override days overdue count. If omitted, calculated from due date. / Dias de retraso. Si se omite, se calcula a partir de la fecha de vencimiento.

tools.name: attendance_clock_in
tools.title: Clock In (Attendance)
tools.description: Record an employee clock-in. Optionally captures mood (employee well-being tracking) and location (remote/office/site). Returns an attendance entry with status='open'. Pair with attendance_clock_out to close the entry. / Registra una entrada de fichaje. Captura opcionalmente estado de animo y ubicacion.

mood.description: Optional mood slug (e.g. 'great','ok','tired') / Estado de animo

tools.name: attendance_clock_out
tools.title: Clock Out (Attendance)
tools.description: Close an open attendance entry. Stamps clockOutAt and computes durationMinutes. Idempotent: clocking out an already-closed entry is a no-op. / Cierra una entrada de fichaje abierta. Calcula la duracion en minutos.

entryId.description: Open attendance entry ID / ID de la entrada abierta

tools.name: categorize_transaction
tools.title: Categorize Transaction
tools.description: Apply a category to a bank transaction for manual classification. Categories map to expense categories for tax deduction tracking. Example: id='tx_abc', category='supplies', notes='Office paper Q1' / Asigna una categoria a un movimiento bancario. Las categorias se mapean a categorias de gastos para el control de deducciones fiscales.

notes.description: Optional notes for this classification / Notas opcionales

tools.name: create_client
tools.title: Create Client
tools.description: Create a new client/customer. Requires at minimum a name. Clients are used when creating invoices and quotes. Example: name='Acme Corp', email='billing@acme.com', taxId='B12345678', address={street:'Main St 1', city:'Madrid', country:'ES'} / Crea un nuevo cliente. Requiere como minimo un nombre. Los clientes se usan al crear facturas y presupuestos.

name.description: Client/company name / Nombre del cliente o empresa

state.description: State or province / Provincia o comunidad autonoma

tools.name: create_client_contact
tools.title: Create Client Contact
tools.description: Add a new contact person to a client. Requires a name at minimum. Example: clientId='abc123', name='Ana Garcia', email='ana@acme.com', role='CTO', isPrimary=true / Anade un nuevo contacto a un cliente. Requiere al menos un nombre.

role.description: Role or title (e.g. CEO, CTO, Billing) / Cargo o rol

isPrimary.description: Whether this is the primary contact / Si es el contacto principal

tools.name: create_client_note
tools.title: Create Client Note
tools.description: Add a note to a client. Notes are free-form text entries useful for keeping context. Example: clientId='abc123', content='Prefers invoices in English. Payment NET 30.' / Anade una nota a un cliente. Las notas son texto libre para mantener contexto.

content.description: Note content / Contenido de la nota

tools.name: create_credit_note
tools.title: Create Credit Note
tools.description: Create a full credit note (factura rectificativa) for an existing invoice, as a DRAFT. It does NOT issue: the draft carries no fiscal number, no hash and is not sent to VeriFactu — issue it from the app when you are ready. Always rectifies by differences (TipoRectificativa = I). Spanish market: R-type is derived from `reason` (error -> R1, anything else -> R4). Partial credits are not supported. Requires the `pro` plan. / Crea una factura rectificativa completa como BORRADOR. No emite: sin numero fiscal, sin hash, sin envio a VeriFactu. Siempre rectifica por diferencias (tipo I). El tipo R se deriva de `reason` (error -> R1, resto -> R4). No admite abonos parciales. Requiere plan `pro`.

invoiceId.description: ID of the original invoice to credit / ID de la factura original a rectificar

reason.description: Reason for the credit note. Maps to Spanish R-types: error→R1 (art. 80.1), refund/discount/cancellation/other→R4 / Motivo de la rectificacion. error→R1, resto→R4

reasonDescription.description: Optional free-text description of the reason / Descripcion libre del motivo

fullCredit.description: Must be true (the default). `false` is rejected with 400 PARTIAL_CREDIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED — the API has no line-level or partial credit. It does NOT select the rectification method: that is always I (por diferencias). / Debe ser true (por defecto). `false` devuelve 400 PARTIAL_CREDIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. No elige el metodo de rectificacion: siempre es I (por diferencias).

issueDate.description: ISO date for the credit note (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today. / Fecha de emision (YYYY-MM-DD). Por defecto hoy.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional idempotency key, max 64 chars. One is generated per call when omitted or blank; pass your own to make a retry replay the stored result instead of creating a second draft. Reusing a key with a different body returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED — reconcile, do not retry with a new key. / Clave de idempotencia opcional (max 64). Se genera una por llamada si se omite o va vacia.

tools.name: create_deposit
tools.title: Create Deposit
tools.description: Record a new deposit from a client. Requires clientId and amount. Useful for tracking advance payments, retainers, and security deposits. Example: clientId='abc123', amount=500, currency='EUR', description='Project retainer' / Registra un nuevo deposito de un cliente. Requiere clientId e importe. Util para adelantos, retenciones y depositos de garantia.

date.description: Deposit date in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) / Fecha del deposito

status.description: Status (e.g. 'pending', 'applied', 'refunded') / Estado

reference.description: External reference or receipt number / Referencia externa

tools.name: create_expense
tools.title: Create Expense
tools.description: Record a new expense. Requires a description and amount. Useful for tracking business costs, deductible expenses, and vendor payments. Example: description='Office supplies', amount=49.99, category='office', vendor='Amazon', taxDeductible=true / Registra un nuevo gasto. Requiere descripcion e importe. Util para seguimiento de costes, gastos deducibles y pagos a proveedores.

amount.description: Amount in EUR / Importe en EUR

date.description: Expense date in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) / Fecha del gasto

taxDeductible.description: Whether the expense is tax deductible / Si el gasto es deducible fiscalmente

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.title: Create Invoice
tools.description: Create a new invoice. Requires client name and at least one line item. The invoice number is auto-generated. Defaults to draft status and today's date. Example: clientName='Acme Corp', items=[{description:'Consulting', quantity:10, unitPrice:150}], taxRate=21, irpfRate=15 / Crea una nueva factura. Requiere nombre del cliente y al menos un concepto. El numero se genera automaticamente. Por defecto estado borrador y fecha de hoy. Soporta retencion IRPF (autonomos ES), recargo de equivalencia, serie, anticipo y descuento global.

clientId.description: Existing client ID — server back-fills taxId/address / ID de cliente existente

clientTaxId.description: Client tax ID (NIF/CIF/VAT) shown on the invoice / NIF/CIF del cliente

clientAddress.description: Client billing address shown on the invoice / Direccion fiscal del cliente

items.description: Line items (each with description, quantity, unitPrice) / Conceptos de la factura

description.description: Description of the line item / Descripcion del concepto

unitPrice.description: Unit price in EUR / Precio unitario en EUR

issueDate.description: Issue date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD), defaults to today / Fecha de emision

dueDate.description: Due date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD) / Fecha de vencimiento

status.description: Invoice status (default: draft) / Estado de la factura

notes.description: Additional notes shown on the invoice / Notas adicionales

taxRate.description: Tax rate percentage (e.g. 21 for 21% IVA, 7 for IGIC) / Porcentaje de impuesto

irpfRate.description: IRPF withholding % (retencion autonomo ES, e.g. 15 or 7) / Retencion IRPF %

equivalenceSurchargeRate.description: Recargo de equivalencia % (ES retail regime) / Recargo de equivalencia %

clientLocation.description: Fiscal zone driving IVA vs IGIC vs exempt / Zona fiscal (IVA/IGIC/exento)

prepayment.description: Prepaid/advance amount already collected in EUR / Anticipo cobrado en EUR

discountRate.description: Global discount % applied to the invoice / Descuento global %

seriesId.description: Invoice numbering series ID / ID de serie de numeracion

documentNumber.description: Externally-issued number for import (honored verbatim) / Numero externo para importacion

poNumber.description: Client purchase-order reference / Numero de pedido del cliente

operationType.description: Operation type (service or goods) / Tipo de operacion

tools.name: create_product
tools.title: Create Product
tools.description: Create a new product or service in the catalog. Requires a name and unit price. Products can be referenced when creating invoices and quotes for faster data entry. Example: name='Web Design', unitPrice=1500, taxRate=21, description='Full website redesign' / Crea un nuevo producto o servicio en el catalogo. Requiere nombre y precio unitario. Los productos se pueden usar al crear facturas y presupuestos para entrada rapida de datos.

name.description: Product/service name / Nombre del producto o servicio

unitPrice.description: Unit price in EUR / Precio unitario en EUR

taxRate.description: Default tax rate % (e.g. 21 for 21% IVA) / IVA por defecto

tools.name: create_quote
tools.title: Create Quote
tools.description: Create a new quote/estimate for a client. Requires client name and at least one line item. Quotes can later be converted to invoices. Defaults to draft status. Example: clientName='Acme Corp', items=[{description:'Design', quantity:1, unitPrice:3000}], validUntil='2026-04-30' / Crea un nuevo presupuesto. Requiere nombre del cliente y al menos un concepto. clientTaxId.description: Client tax ID (NIF/CIF/VAT) / NIF/CIF del cliente

clientAddress.description: Client billing address / Direccion fiscal del cliente

issueDate.description: Issue date in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD), defaults to today / Fecha de emision

dueDate.description: Due date in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) / Fecha de vencimiento

taxRate.description: Tax rate % (e.g. 21 IVA, 7 IGIC) / Porcentaje de impuesto

irpfRate.description: IRPF withholding % (retencion autonomo ES) / Retencion IRPF %

equivalenceSurchargeRate.description: Recargo de equivalencia % / Recargo de equivalencia %

clientLocation.description: Fiscal zone driving IVA vs IGIC vs exempt / Zona fiscal

items.description: Line items (each with description, quantity, unitPrice) / Conceptos del presupuesto

description.description: Description of the line item / Descripcion del concepto

unitPrice.description: Unit price in EUR / Precio unitario en EUR

validUntil.description: Expiry date in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) / Fecha de validez

notes.description: Additional notes shown on the quote / Notas adicionales

status.description: Quote status (default: draft) / Estado del presupuesto

tools.name: create_recurring_invoice
tools.title: Create Recurring Invoice
tools.description: Create a new recurring invoice template. Specify frequency (daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly/yearly), recipient client, line items, and optional start date. The first invoice instance is generated on the next scheduled run date. Example: clientId='cli_abc', frequency='monthly', templateName='Servicio mensual', lineItems=[{description:'SaaS', quantity:1, unitPrice:299}] / Crea una nueva plantilla de factura recurrente. templateName.description: Name for this recurring template / Nombre de la plantilla

clientId.description: Client ID (recipient of generated invoices) / ID del cliente destinatario

lineItems.description: Invoice line items / Lineas de la factura

description.description: Line item description / Descripcion de la linea

startDate.description: First billing date ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to next natural cycle date. / Primera fecha de facturacion (por defecto proximo ciclo natural)

taxRate.description: Tax rate percentage (e.g. 21 for 21% IVA) / Tipo impositivo (e.g. 21 para IVA 21%)

notes.description: Notes to include on generated invoices / Notas a incluir en las facturas generadas

tools.name: create_reservation
tools.title: Create Reservation
tools.description: Create a new reservation manually (not via channel sync). Requires property ID, check-in/check-out dates, and guest count. guestId.description: Existing guest ID (if known) / ID de huesped existente

guest.description: New guest data (used if guestId not provided) / Datos del nuevo huesped si no se proporciona guestId

idDocument.description: DNI/passport number / Numero de DNI o pasaporte

country.description: Country ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g. ES, DE) / Pais

checkIn.description: Check-in date YYYY-MM-DD / Fecha de entrada

checkOut.description: Check-out date YYYY-MM-DD / Fecha de salida

guestCount.description: Number of guests / Numero de huespedes

channelId.description: Booking channel ID (Airbnb, Booking.com, Direct) / Canal de reserva

totalAmount.description: Total amount in workspace currency / Importe total

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency (defaults to workspace currency) / Divisa

date.description: Work date ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) / Fecha del trabajo

description.description: Description of work done / Descripcion del trabajo realizado

billable.description: Whether hours are billable to client (default true) / Si las horas son facturables

userId.description: User ID (defaults to API key owner) / ID del usuario (por defecto el propietario de la API key)

tools.name: create_vendor

tools.description: Create a new vendor/supplier. Requires at minimum a name. Vendors are used when tracking expenses and purchase orders. state.description: State or province / Provincia o comunidad autonoma

events.description: Events to subscribe to (e.g. ['invoice.created', 'invoice.paid']) / Eventos a suscribir

tools.name: einvoice_export
tools.title: Export E-Invoice XML
tools.description:
Export an invoice as e-invoicing XML in a specific format. Supports Facturae (ES B2G), XRechnung-CII (DE), XRechnung-UBL (DE), Factur-X profiles (FR), FatturaPA (IT), PEPPOL-BIS-3 (EU network), UBL and CII (generic). For Facturae, set signed=true to get XAdES-enveloped XML for FACe/AEAT submission. Returns a signed download URL valid for 24 hours. 

/ Exporta una factura como XML de facturacion electronica en el formato especificado. Para Facturae con signed=true devuelve XML firmado XAdES para envio a FACe/AEAT.

invoiceId.description: Frihet invoice ID to export / ID de la factura a exportar

format.description: E-invoice format. Choose based on recipient country: ES B2G→facturae, DE→xrechnung-cii/ubl, FR→facturx-*, IT→fatturapa, EU PEPPOL→peppol-bis-3, generic→ubl or cii / Formato de factura electronica.

signed.description: If true, returns XAdES-enveloped signed XML (Facturae only). Requires workspace signing certificate configured. / Si true, devuelve XML firmado XAdES (solo Facturae). Requiere certificado de firma configurado.

tools.name: export_datev
tools.title: Export DATEV
tools.description:
Export accounting data in DATEV EXTF format for import into DATEV Kanzlei-Rechnungswesen or compatible systems. Returns a signed download URL valid for 24 hours. 

Supported EXTF formats:

tools.name: send_einvoice
tools.title: Send E-Invoice
tools.description:
Dispatch an e-invoice to the recipient via the selected transport channel. Returns immediately with a workflowRunId — use get_einvoice_status to poll until completion. 

Supported formats (11 total):
  • xrechnung-cii — XRechnung CII syntax (Germany B2G mandatory)
  • xrechnung-ubl — XRechnung UBL 2.1 syntax (Germany B2G alternative)
  • facturx-en16931 — Factur-X EN16931 PDF/A-3 (France, EU)
  • facturx-extended — Factur-X Extended with trade/logistics fields (France, EU)
  • facturx-basic — Factur-X Basic reduced field set (France, EU)
  • facturx-minimum — Factur-X Minimum for summary invoices (France, EU)
  • fatturapa — FatturaPA XML via SDI hub (Italy mandatory)
  • ubl — Generic UBL 2.1 XML (EU/global)
  • cii — Generic CII Cross Industry Invoice (EU/global)
  • peppol-bis-3 — PEPPOL BIS Billing 3.0 network (EU/Nordic/AU/SG)
  • facturae — Facturae 3.2.x (Spain B2G via FACe/AEAT mandatory)

Dispatch modes:
  • email — attach XML/PDF and send via Resend to client email on file
  • chorus_pro — submit to French Chorus Pro portal (facturx-* only)
  • sdi — submit to Italian SDI hub (fatturapa only)
  • peppol — transmit via PEPPOL access point (peppol-bis-3 only)
  • download — generate and return a signed download URL only

If the dispatch backend is not deployed for this workspace, returns an honest 'unavailable' response — never fabricated workflow data. / Envia una factura electronica al destinatario mediante el canal de transporte seleccionado. Devuelve de forma asincrona — consultar get_einvoice_status para seguimiento.

invoiceId.description: Frihet invoice ID to dispatch / ID de la factura a enviar

format.description: E-invoice format. Choose based on recipient country and channel: DE→xrechnung-cii/ubl, FR→facturx-*, IT→fatturapa, ES B2G→facturae, EU PEPPOL→peppol-bis-3, generic→ubl or cii / Formato de factura electronica.
